rules.statement: A trustee is authorized to make payments for the purposes enumerated in section 20 of the Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance, No. 8 of 1905, and such payments cannot be regarded as improper or made ultra vires merely because the sanction and approval of the District Committee was not obtained.
rules.supporting_quote: "That the section empowers a trustee to make such payments is emphasized by section 21 (b) which imposes the duty on trustees of keeping accounts ' of the disbursements made by them ' for the purposes defined in section 20. The learned Judge has drawn the inference that, the sanction of the District Committee is a condition precedent to the payments being lawfully made from the fact that in two of the forms appended to the rules made by the District Committee under section 12 of the Ordinance there occur the words ' date of sanction and No. of authority given by the District Committee.' However desirable it may be for trustees to make only such payments as the District Committee approve of, the mere occurrence of these words in these forms cannot in my opinion fetter or derogate from the express powers of expenditure which are vested in trustees under section 20."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 20 of the Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance, No. 8 of 1905.
